evidence.reason: Valid. `Outbox.spool` validates and then durably writes `canonical(value)` without enforcing the record-size bound that `GitLedger.publish` applies to pending records. An oversized review can therefore be accepted and persisted, then rejected on every publish attempt, leaving a poison pending file that blocks later valid records. The smallest compatible fix is to enforce the same `RECORD_BYTES` bound on the canonical record in `spool` before the `atomic` write.
